## EnforceCallOptions.risk property

Pre-computed risk class of the operation, required to enforce `read-only` semantics (only `'read'`<!-- -->-risk-class operations are permitted under a `read-only` rule).

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly risk: RiskClass;
```
